sources.title: Qwen3 1.7B Fine-Tuning Guide - distil labs
sources.snippet: Qwen3 1.7B Fine-Tuning Guide Qwen3-1.7B is the model the distil labs docs tell you to start with when you have no stronger constraint. It is small enough to serve on a modest GPU, ranks mid-table after fine-tuning across eight tasks, and supports every task type the platform offers, including tool calling.

sources.title: Qwen 3 1.7B | Intel® Software Catalog
sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B is a high-density, ultra-efficient language model designed for extreme throughput on server CPUs. Its compact architecture allows for massive parallelization, making it an ideal choice for high-volume inference tasks where latency and resource utilization are primary concerns.
